answer_value: Quarter with vertical line from top edge to arc and diagonal to right edge, semicircles on arc
steps: Bottom-right quadrant is the mirror image of top-right quadrant across the horizontal diameter
So bottom-left must be the mirror image of top-left across the horizontal diameter
Top-left: small semicircles on the arc, a vertical line from a point on the horizontal radius to the arc, and a slanted line from that point to the vertical radius
Mirrored: vertical line going down from the horizontal radius to the arc, slanted line from its foot to the vertical radius (right edge), semicircles along the arc
